title: Excellent location and genuinely helpful staff
text: Excellent location and genuinely helpful staff. The room was clean, quiet and close to transport.

title: Comfortable but room showed some wear
text: Comfortable stay, though the room showed some wear and the air conditioning was noisy.

title: Check-in took too long
text: Check-in took too long and the receptionist was not very helpful. The bathroom was not properly cleaned.

title: Great value near the station
text: Great value for money, clean room and a very convenient location near the train station.

title: Friendly service
text: Friendly staff and a good central location. The bed was comfortable and the shower worked well.

title: Street noise disrupted sleep
text: Street noise was noticeable at night and there was dust under the bed. Location and staff were good.

title: Lovely neighbourhood and comfortable bed
text: Lovely neighbourhood location, comfortable bed and helpful staff at reception.

title: The room was dated and noisy
text: The room was dated and there was too much street noise. Housekeeping missed the bathroom bin.

title: Spotless and easy check-in
text: Spotless room, easy check-in and a friendly receptionist. Excellent service overall.

title: Good location but lift was slow
text: Good location and clean facilities, but the lift was slow and the room felt small.

title: Expensive for the condition
text: The price was expensive for the room condition. Air conditioning was weak and staff seemed rushed.

title: Charming stay
text: Charming property in a great area. Reception was helpful and the room was clean.

title: Outstanding central location
text: Outstanding central location, modern room and very helpful staff. Fast check-in and excellent cleanliness.

title: Convenient and mostly quiet
text: Convenient stay close to the station. The room was comfortable, though the lift was noisy.

title: Room maintenance needs attention
text: Room condition needs attention: the shower leaked and the bathroom was not clean. Staff were polite but slow.

title: Good but parking was difficult
text: Good location and friendly receptionist, but parking was difficult and the room felt hot.

title: Clean and reliable
text: Clean room, reliable hot water and a great value close to central Sydney.

title: Wi-Fi and noise issues
text: The Wi-Fi was poor and the street noise made sleep difficult. Reception was helpful and the bed was clean.

title: Great harbour views
text: Great location near Darling Harbour, helpful staff and a clean room with excellent facilities.

title: Poor value and slow housekeeping
text: Poor value for money. Housekeeping was slow, the bathroom was dirty and the receptionist was rude.

title: Wonderful service
text: Wonderful service from staff and a smooth check-in. The room was spotless and close to everything.

title: Good stay with minor noise
text: Good stay, clean facilities and excellent location. Minor noise from the lift and corridor.

title: Room condition disappointed
text: The room condition was disappointing with a broken lamp and old furniture. Staff did respond when asked.

title: Comfortable central stay
text: Comfortable bed, central location and friendly check-in. Wi-Fi was adequate and the price was reasonable.
